faces.name: 星龍王ガイアール・リュウセイドラゴン
faces.typeText: サイキック・スーパー・クリーチャー
faces.abilityText:
バトルゾーンにある自分のクリーチャーはすべて「スピードアタッカー」を得る。
相手のサイキック・クリーチャーは攻撃・ブロックできない。

※覚醒リンクするために必要なカード(ウコン・ピッピー/サコン・ピッピー/流星のフォーエバー・カイザー)

Ukon native own Dragon2000 aura, Sakon exact own-start3-cell link and mandatory link解除 reused. Forever player-only opposing Psychic restriction uses narrow live-source guard and applies even to ignored recipients. QA36434 actual ordinary Janus, linked KillerDragon Super and Evolution RedZoneBuster cannot attack player; QA36435 they may attack tapped creatures and block. Back live Psychic combat restriction covers both player/creature attack and blocking; ignored/sealed source removes it; real Diamond Cutter player-only override preserved. Own native continuous speed aura and19k/T verified both players.

Back new serializable PsychicMill1734 optional choice uses native simultaneous mill2, excludes replacement cards not in grave, stops on deck loss and creates one independent native optional extra Select for EACH actual milled card cost. No summed budget, repeated physical selection, false summons or extra mana. Current rule201.2b permits either twinpact printed cost; selecting within maximum represents the union of legal reference choices for one optional Psychic. Real2/6 cost caps, twin2/4, chosen Janus back face, decline each step, Senno/5000GT, last2 library CPU decline/human loss, actual Kikuchi deck-shuffle replacement, native CIP timing, encrypted actions and AI purity verified.

57 unique focused cases passed first attempts (49 initial+8 additional); extra AI case label corrected without body change. Related actual P-invasion/link/Diamond, positively selected short intrinsic attack restrictions and mill replacement, online/save regressions pass. npm run check, official full faces/limits, audit and nameKey/ID invariants pass.
